# Termux-STT (v1.0.9)
> Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure Python 128d X-Vector Speaker Diarization

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt
- Installation: `pip install termux-stt
# or: npm install termux-stt`
- Architecture: Integrates Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with a closed-form pure-Python 128-dimensional X-Vector clustering algorithm that operates in under 80MB RAM.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_stt as stt

# 1. Transcribe audio with speaker diarization
engine = stt.STTEngine(model="whisper-tiny")
result = engine.transcribe_with_diarization("meeting.wav")

for seg in result.segments:
    print(f"[{seg.speaker}] ({seg.start:.1f}s - {seg.end:.1f}s): {seg.text}")

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
